caption: Ngwa Nforbi v. Hertz Global Holdings, Inc.
claims: None asserted. Prospective employment-screening monitoring only.
status: October 23, 2026: accepted conditional Manager Trainee offer remains in HireRight screening. Applicant completed disclosures/authorizations and requested a free report copy. HireRight furnished an MVR Express report containing public-record information to The Hertz Corporation at 3:05 p.m.; the underlying MVR report and any criminal-search results are not yet in the record. No adverse action documented.
defendants: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. (requested matter caption; ADP WOTC entity); The Hertz Corporation (offer issuer, requesting employer, and recipient identified in HireRight notice). Entity roles and any proper defendant require confirmation if a dispute arises.
note: Monitoring workspace only, not a filed case or present accusation. HireRight is now confirmed as the employment-screening vendor; ADP remains the separate WOTC vendor. The California HireRight disclosure lists MVR Express and several criminal/public-record products, including National Sex Offender Registry. A product listing or authorization does not establish which search returned information, what source was used, or that Hertz took adverse action.
key_facts: October 22: The Hertz Corporation offered, and applicant accepted, a full-time Manager Trainee position at 816 San Antonio Rd., Palo Alto, at $23/hour. October 23 at 12:37 p.m.: Gloria Williams sent pre-boarding instructions and HireRight sent a background-verification request. Applicant electronically completed disclosures and authorizations at 3:03–3:04 p.m. and checked the California option requesting a free report copy. The California disclosure lists Criminal Felony & Misdemeanor, Managed Adjudication 3.0, Federal Criminal, SSN Trace, MVR Express, National Sex Offender Registry, Widescreen Plus National Criminal Search, and Prohibited Parties. At 3:05 p.m. HireRight notified applicant that an MVR Express report containing public-record information was furnished to Gloria Williams at The Hertz Corporation. The supplied document is a furnishing notice, not the underlying MVR report. Several signed forms use Brendan Ngehsi Ngwanforbi, creating a name-variant issue to monitor.
procedural_status: Pre-filing evidence-preservation and onboarding-monitoring matter. No complaint, docket, adverse-action notice, individualized assessment, rescission, or lost start is documented. HireRight screening is active; obtain the actual MVR and any full consumer report and preserve any employer response.
